components.name: Book Card
components.description: A minimal, lifting card used to display book covers and metadata.
components.html:
The Vital Question
Nick Lane
Micro
components.css: .ds-book-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; padding: 12px 10px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background-color: #fff; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; font-family: serif; } .ds-book-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.11); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-book-image { max-width: 120px; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 3px; margin: 0 auto; box-shadow: 2px 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-book-title { font-size: 1em; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #1a1a1a; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-book-author { color: #777; font-size: 1em; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-book-note { color: #999; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.9em; margin-top: 6px; line-height: 1.3; }

narrative.overview: The current design is a highly minimal, restrained environment that acts as a silent backdrop for the content. Anchored by the classic Calendas Plus serif font, it prioritizes reading experience and content structure over decoration. It serves as a utilitarian but elegant starting point that gets out of the way entirely.
keyCharacteristics: Generous use of whitespace and simple borders.
dos: Do use the Calendas Plus font for all primary reading material to maintain the classic manuscript feel.
Do rely on generous whitespace and simple borders rather than heavy background colors to separate content.
donts: Don't use heavy shadows on text or structural layout elements; reserve depth for interactive components like cards.
